name: Amy Klobuchar

lean.basis: Democratic–Farmer–Labor U.S. senator from Minnesota since 2007, a member of the Senate Democratic leadership, and 2020 presidential candidate; known as a pragmatic, bipartisan-leaning Democrat.

office.title: U.S. senator from Minnesota (governor-elect; takes office January 4, 2027); chair, Senate Democratic Steering and Policy Committee

current_role: U.S. senator from Minnesota (since 2007); governor-elect of Minnesota (elected November 2026)
summary: Amy Klobuchar, a former Hennepin County attorney, has been a Democratic U.S. senator from Minnesota since 2007 and ran for president in 2020 before endorsing Joe Biden. After Governor Tim Walz dropped his reelection bid in January 2026 she ran for governor and won on November 3, 2026 with about 55.5% of the vote against Republican Lisa Demuth, becoming the state's first woman elected governor.

connections.name: Joe Biden
connections.description: Klobuchar ended her 2020 campaign on March 2, 2020 and endorsed Biden before Super Tuesday; she was reported as a possible running mate and was the first speaker at his inauguration.

connections.name: Chuck Schumer
connections.description: A member of Schumer's Senate Democratic leadership team, chairing the Steering (now Steering and Policy) Committee since 2015.

connections.name: Barack Obama
connections.description: Klobuchar endorsed Obama in the 2008 primaries on March 30, 2008 and pledged her superdelegate vote to him.

connections.name: Lisa Demuth
connections.description: Klobuchar defeated the Republican House speaker Demuth for governor in November 2026, about 55.5% to 42.6%.
